title: Recovery of a coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\\rho$ assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of three states: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. If $J$ is the set of free coordinates and each coordinate outside $J$ is assigned the sign specified by $\\rho$, then the restriction determined by $J$ and those signs is exactly $\\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\rho$ assigns one of the three restriction states to every coordinate
